{{Top|leg}}
A '''taxidermist''' was an individual who specialized in the stuffing and mounting of dead animals for display, generally as [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trophies. Taxidermists were required to specially prepare [[Camray eel]]s from [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] for show; despite being much sought after as trophies, the stench that emanated from the corpse upon death was vile. Taxidermists prepared the body in such a way as to eliminate the odour.<ref name="Spira">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref> The [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]] [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] employed a taxidermist to stuff the prey he killed.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
